decoded.meaning: FWD{ op=READ, dst=/net/can/conn, FIELD :schema, src=/reply-ep } — RFC-0014 §6's creatability probe. Against a node that declares no `can` module the reply is ERROR{tr::path::not_found} (0x0020), which the orchestrator reads as "not creatable"
decoded.note: The probe exists BECAUSE §3 hides `conn` from `/net/<module>:children[]` — enumeration can never reveal the endpoint, so §6 makes reading its `:schema` the sanctioned way to learn it is there. The absent answer is `tr::path::not_found` (0x0020), the missing-`/`-vertex identity, matching RFC-0009 §A.1.1; `tr::schema::not_found` (0x0031) is reserved for the different case of a PRESENT endpoint given an unknown config type (RFC-0014 §Compatibility). The same bytes against a node that DOES declare the module answer a RESULT — nothing in this frame is inherently an error.
